title: Equiangular lines in dimensions 18 to 20
text:
equiangular lines in dimensions 18 to 20

the most lines through a point with every pair at the same angle is exactly 57 in 18 dimensions, 72 in 19 and 90 in 20. the best published bounds were 59, 74, 94.

solved by valjakas djaljapayan, zhen-qi liao and wei-hsuan yu with gpt-6
